title: Toyota's Next Electric Car Has a Gas Engine. Here's Why #shorts

scenes.text: Toyota's newest electric car has a gas engine inside. It debuts at the Guangzhou auto show in China.
It's called a range extender. Electric motors drive the wheels. The gas engine only works as a generator, recharging the battery when it runs low.
And in China, buyers love it. Xiaomi's first range extenders launched in September. By October, they were over half of all the cars Xiaomi sold.
Meanwhile, Toyota's sales in China are down about nineteen percent so far this year. So it's joining in.
The catch? It still burns gas, and it's less efficient than a pure electric car.
Smart bridge, or step back? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
